title: 天皇賞（春）の後に・光を浴びて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In a huge upset, Mejiro McQueen does not take her third consecutive victory. Rice Shower emerges victorious instead.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hearing the words of congratulations from her fans and friends, Rice Shower is overcome with emotion as she realizes she has made them all smile.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Before the winning concert, Mejiro McQueen gives her an encouraging push forward.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She heads to the stage, set on expressing her gratitude to the fans who supported her.
